notes.title: 🥳 M.O.O.D.S. Early Access Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/cb4b69f295f784b928505ae4c9f51c082908142e.png[/img]

[h1]🥳 M.O.O.D.S. will be released on Steam Early Access on July 29th!🥳 [/h1]

[b]M.O.O.D.S.[/b], aka Mechanical Organisms on Destructive Substances. It is a [b]top-down roguelike twin-stick shooter[/b] where you [b]fight crazed robots with futuristic guns equipped with switchable addin modifications[/b]. A long time ago, humans left the Earth, and to become more like their creators, mechs implanted themselves with an Emotion Module to feel the moods people had experienced. It did not go well.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1956770/MOODS/

[h3][b]Four Years of Development in One Image[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/d3ebd7c2d71fc92c6ac28544e0342b19a98abf14.gif[/img]

[h3]Main Gameplay: [/h3][olist]
[*] [b]The main innovative part of the gameplay is short talks with Bosses before the battle[/b]. In games like Hades or Tiny Rogue boss dialogue is an essential part of world-building. But in M.O.O.D.S., the emotion you choose to answer with will affect how your next boss battle will go. Valery will be weakened by a sad or lovable answer, but she will add cryo to her bullets if your answer is fired with anger.
[*] [b]Addins modifications[/b] are another curious addition. You can [b]switch them at any time between the two weapons you carry[/b]. Some addins work better with one type of weapons, others will add some interesting effects in general, and some… are here just to bring chaos. For example, Acid Puddle Addin that leaves said puddles while bullets fly works best with fast-shooting weapons with many bullets in the magazine, like a Swarm Emitter or Arcblaster. But it is useless with sniper-type weapons. Psst! Never try Glitcher Addin —you have been warned.
[*] [b]Classes are presented with 5 Emotions[/b]: Joy that summons an auto-shooting turret, Pride that covers itself with a reflective shield, Love that charms enemies to fight on your side, Anger that increases your fire rate, and Sorrow with its taunting mech-dog. More curious are the upgrades for the class abilities. Like Anger’s upgrade to prolong ability effect time with each kill, making it an OP skill for otherwise challenging rooms.
[*] M.O.O.D.S. is more than a roguelike survivor-like game. Aside from [b]dungeon-crawler-like[/b] maps filled with enemies to shoot, you will find [b]NPCs with quests[/b], [b]secret and challenge rooms[/b], or enemies that run away and drop more cash when killed. There are elements of [b]base-building[/b], where you start in a lame flying junkyard and then [b]build workshops for your NPC friends[/b]. Also, there is a [b]shared-screen local co-op[/b] to play with friends on Steam or when someone crashes at your place.
[/olist]

[h3]Brand New Trailer[/h3]
[previewyoutube=jMIINegXVb8;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]The Content Roadmap is coming soon![/i]

-StickyStone Studio

notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.notes:
Dear Memorrhians, 
we present the long awaited Update V1.6 with the manual savegame feature.
Furthermore the regional pricing for some countries were adjusted.

[b]IMPORTANT: Savegames from 1.5 and under are NOT compatible with the 1.6! To checkout the older version install the Update 1.5 branch in your steam library! [/b]

[b]Patchnotes:[/b]
- Added a [b]manual savegame option[/b] to allow manual savegames (Finally!)
- Reduced CPU load by 40% and RAM usage by over 50%
- Improve loading and saving times
- Major Upgrade to the 2020.3.38f1 Unity Engine
- Fixed a physic bug in the elevator
- Fixed two door bugs in the temple
- Fixed a bunch of savegame bugs that could occur with the old savegame system
- Adjusted controller configurations and updated it to support even more controllers 
- A lot of small visual glitches, bugfixes and unnecessary loadings of objects was improved

[b]Why did it take us so long to do this?:[/b]
One reason the port to consoles took so long is the game's savegame system and the way Memorrha loads into RAM. So we rewrote the [b]entire[/b] Savegame-System and changed the level loading behavior. Unfortunately this was very time consuming - but now it's done!

With the V1.6 update it will now be possible to save manually. This is really a big step and we are happy that we can finally make this possible. The old savegames will not be compatible with the V1.6 update, so we have provided a V1.5 on Steam beta branch.

[b]One more really important request: [/b]
We as a small indie studio rely a lot on reviews, our heart and soul goes into this project. 
If you liked Memorrha it would REALLY help us if you leave a positive review on Steam. 

Thank you very much! ːsteamthumbsupː

- The StickyStoneStudio Team -

notes.title: Memorrha Update V1.2
notes.notes:
Dear Memorrhians,
We just released our second big update fixing some issues that were reported to us during the last week.
Thanks a lot to all the players who have supported us diligently in troubleshooting and are still doing so. 

- [b]Always running[/b] option added to the game
- Increased the possible [b]FOV to 100[/b] and adjusted the value related to camera clipping behavior
- When emptying an amphora with liquid the animation is now stopped when the player drops the amphora or moves away from the container
- When picking up an amphora that is currently filling up the animation now stops instead of continuing until the amphora is full
- Adjusted culling triggers in the abyss section to lessen object popup
- Adjusted doors in the abyss section to not create slight collider bumps in the floor anymore
- Adjusted the elevator to prevent objects placed on the elevator from stuttering during elevator movement and stopped the walking sound from constantly starting up in fast succession
- Added certain safeguard measures for several elevators to prevent players from breaking their game if they manage to circumvent the respective colliders
- Adjusted the credits
- Improved the charge sound in the energy color puzzle
- Fixed a particle bug that would cause particles to continue emitting under certain conditions instead of properly fading
- Further adjustments to world colliders
- Corrected certain texture bugs in the cellar
- The master volume slider setting now does not reset when choosing between graphical preset profiles
- Fixed a controller related bug that would allow players to open the main menu when already being in the options menu

The next update will focus on mine cart puzzles, stay tuned!
As always, thank you so much for playing Memorrha! ːreheartː
